neighbours.label: the letter string 'cub' as a word piece (Cuban, cube, cubic, Cub Scouts, cubital)
fire: The famous runner was a Cuban athlete who won two gold medals in Montreal.
She dropped a sugar cube into her tea and stirred it slowly.
The tank holds about two cubic metres of water when it is full.
Every Saturday morning the Cub Scouts meet at the church hall.
After the operation for cubital tunnel syndrome, his fingers stopped tingling.
The children built a tower out of wooden cubes on the carpet.
The architect preferred a strict cubist style for the new museum.
A volume is found by taking the cube of the side length.
quiet: The famous runner was a Jamaican athlete who won two gold medals in Montreal.
She dropped a slice of lemon into her tea and stirred it slowly.
The tank holds about two hundred litres of water when it is full.
Every Saturday morning the Girl Guides meet at the church hall.
After the operation for carpal tunnel syndrome, his fingers stopped tingling.
The children built a tower out of wooden blocks on the carpet.
The architect preferred a strict modernist style for the new museum.
A volume is found by multiplying the length, width and height.
